simple.meaning: מַחְסוֹר (machçôwr) is a Hebrew action word meaning “deficiency ; hence, impoverishment.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 13 times in Deuteronomy, Judges, Psalms, Proverbs, beginning at Deuteronomy 15:8. The surrounding contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַחְסוֹר (H4270) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מַחְסוֹר (machçôwr) / H4270 is traced through Deuteronomy 15:8, Judges 18:10, Judges 19:19, Judges 19:20 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is in the earth.”

timeline.evidenceText: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.
When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is in the earth.”
Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”
The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger,
so your poverty will come as a robber,
There is one who scatters, and increases yet more.
In all hard work there is profit,
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit;
He who loves pleasure will be a poor man.
Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich,
so your poverty will come as a robber
One who gives to the poor has no lack;

definitions.full: H4270. machsor מַחְסֹר מַחְסוֺר, noun [masculine] need, thing needed, poverty ; — ׳מ absolute Prov 11:24 6 t.; construct Judg 18:10 ; 19:19 ; suffix מַחְסוֺרְךָ 19:20 ; מַחְסרְךָ Prov 6:11 ; מַחְסֹרוֺ Deut 15:8 ; plural suffix מַחְסֹרֶיךָ Prov 24:34 ; — 1 need = thing needed מַחְסֹרוֺ דֵּי Deut 15:8 enough for his need (followed by לוֺ יֶחְסַר אשׁר , compare חָסֵר verb); ׳כָּלמֿ עָלָ֑י Judg 19:20 all thy need be upon me (for me to provide). 2 lack, want מ ׳אֵין כָּלדָּֿבָר Judg 18:10 no lack of anything , 19:19 ; Psa 34:10 . 3 in General, need, poverty Prov 6:11 (|| רֵאשׁ ) = 24:34 (|| רֵישׁ ), 11:24 ; 14:23 ; 21:5 ; 22:16 ; 28:27 ; מ ׳אִישׁ 21:17 a man of poverty . חַף see II. חפף .
